name: sredio
description: A small Zapier-inspired workflow automation app (TypeScript, MEAN stack).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sredio/api" "npm run start -w @sredio/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sredio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sredio/api && npm run typecheck -w @sredio/web
